gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-syriac-easter: Expressive and a little swaggering, Warnes stretches its tubelike, constant-weight letters wide while Noto Sans Syriac Eastern keeps its curve endings well apart. Heading and text sit comfortably as sans-serif partners.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wester: Warnes draws every line as flat, unmodulated wire, with ink strokes tapering out before they touch. Noto Sans Syriac Western is dense and small-lettered, like bundled cable, so the wide, short heading gets all the room to show off.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Wide, bold, and wired with zero contrast. Noto Sans Tagalog supplies a generous curve and a dominant middle zone, so Warnes can stretch out above it while the text stays sturdy and open.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Warnes runs a thread of ink with no swelling or tapering, spaced wide and spoken loudly. Noto Sans Tagbanwa answers with open curves and lowercase filling most of its height, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads approachably, its tapering ink strokes and tiny cap-to-lowercase step keeping every line smooth and level. Warnes, squeezed out like toothpaste, adds a loud thread above it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Expressive and bold, Warnes has no pinched joints or flared ends, just stretched ink lines that taper away. Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalk-board lowercase toward the capital line, with open c shapes you can see into: Warnes shouts, the sans-serif text talks.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine mark Warnes out. Noto Sans Tai Viet, with its short ascenders and tall x-height, feels like a quiet, approachable colleague standing beside that loud sans-serif heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-takri: Warnes pulls one unit-width stroke through every letter, stretched wide and tapering at the ends. Noto Sans Takri does the quieter job, with its high-waisted lowercase and unclosed round letters that handle the reading while the heading handles the attention.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Magnified-looking and generous, the text here seems larger than its size, with terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Tamil keeps a longer read breezy and open, while Warnes holds its ruler-straight lines above.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Tamil Supplement shapes its rounds like open parentheses under Warnes, a single-weight outline feel stretched wide. Its tall middle band gives the line a stocky, solid footing.
